Script.name: ChimeraXP online updater
Script.script:
-- ChimeraXP online installer/update manager for Mudlet 5.x. -- Public source only; never needs a GitHub account or access token. -- Keep this bootstrap independent of the Chimera plugin API. chimera_xp_updater = chimera_xp_updater or {} local U = chimera_xp_updater U.base = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gnomidlo/ChimeraXP/main/" U.root = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/ChimeraXP" U.plugin_dir = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/chimera_wtyczki/chimera_autoexp" U.target = U.plugin_dir .. "/init.lua" U.version = "1.0"
local function say(s, color) if type(cecho) == "function" then cecho("\n<" .. (color or "aquamarine") .. ">[ChimeraXP]<reset> " .. tostring(s) .. "\n") end end
local function read(path) local f = io.open(path, "rb") if not f then return nil end local d = f:read("*a") f:close() return d end
local function mkdirs(path) local ok, lfs = pcall(require, "lfs") if not ok or not lfs or type(lfs.mkdir) ~= "function" then return false, "Brak LuaFileSystem (lfs)." end local sep = package.config:sub(1, 1) local current, prefix = "", "" if path:match("^%a:[/\\]") then prefix, path = path:sub(1, 2) .. sep, path:sub(4) elseif path:sub(1, 1) == sep then prefix, path = sep, path:sub(2) end current = prefix for part in path:gmatch("[^/\\]+") do if current ~= "" and current:sub(-1) ~= sep then current = current .. sep end current = current .. part if lfs.attributes(current, "mode") ~= "directory" then local done, err = lfs.mkdir(current) if not done then return false, tostring(err) end end end return true end
local function version(v) local a, b, c, beta = tostring(v or ""):match("^(%d+)%.(%d+)%.(%d+)%-beta%.(%d+)$") if beta then return {tonumber(a), tonumber(b), tonumber(c), 0, tonumber(beta)} end a, b, c = tostring(v or ""):match("^(%d+)%.(%d+)%.(%d+)$") if a then return {tonumber(a), tonumber(b), tonumber(c), 1, 0} end return nil end
local function compare(a, b) local x, y = version(a), version(b) if not y then return nil end if not x then return -1 end for i = 1, 5 do if x[i] < y[i] then return -1 end if x[i] > y[i] then return 1 end end return 0 end
local marker = "-- Chimera AutoExp 5 / standalone plugin" local function plugin_version(data) if not data or data:sub(1, #marker) ~= marker then return nil end return data:match('version%s*=%s*"([%d%.%-beta]+)"') end
local function parse_manifest(data) if not data or not data:find('"name"%s*:%s*"ChimeraXP"') or not data:find('"schema"%s*:%s*1') then return nil end local v = data:match('"version"%s*:%s*"([^"%s]+)"') local file = data:match('"path"%s*:%s*"([^"%s]+)"') local sha = data:match('"sha256"%s*:%s*"([0-9a-f]+)"') if not version(v) or file ~= "plugins/chimera_autoexp/init.lua" or not sha or #sha ~= 64 then return nil end return {version = v, sha256 = sha} end
function U:_cleanup() if self.handlers then for _, handle in ipairs(self.handlers) do pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, handle) end end self.handlers = nil self.waiting = nil end
function U:_fail(message) local filename = self.waiting self:_cleanup() self.busy, self.release = false, nil if filename then pcall(os.remove, filename) end say(message .. " Dotychczasowa instalacja pozostaje bez zmian.", "orange") end
function U:_fetch(stage, url) local destination = self.root .. "/.online-" .. stage .. ".tmp" self:_cleanup() self.waiting, self.stage = destination, stage pcall(os.remove, destination) self.handlers = { registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadDone", function(_, filename) if filename ~= self.waiting then return end self:_downloaded(stage, filename) end), registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadError", function(_, err, filename) if filename ~= self.waiting then return end self:_fail("Nie udalo sie pobrac pliku z GitHuba: " .. tostring(err)) end) } local ok, result, err = pcall(downloadFile, destination, url) if not ok or result == false then self:_fail("Nie mozna uruchomic pobierania: " .. tostring(err or result)) end end
function U:_install(downloaded, remote_version) if not downloaded or downloaded:sub(1, #marker) ~= marker or plugin_version(downloaded) ~= remote_version or #downloaded < 10000 or #downloaded > 500000 then return self:_fail("Pobrany plik nie jest prawidlowa wtyczka ChimeraXP.") end local compile = loadstring or load if not compile or not compile(downloaded, "@chimera_autoexp/init.lua") then return self:_fail("Pobrany plik zawiera blad skladni Lua.") end local existing = read(self.target) if existing and existing:sub(1, #marker) ~= marker then return self:_fail("W katalogu wtyczki jest nierozpoznany plik: " .. self.target) end local installed = plugin_version(existing) if existing and not installed then return self:_fail("Nie rozpoznano wersji poprzedniej wtyczki.") end if existing and compare(installed, remote_version) >= 0 then self:_cleanup(); self.busy, self.release = false, nil if self.verbose then say("Masz juz wersje " .. installed .. ".") end return end local ok, err = mkdirs(self.plugin_dir) if not ok then return self:_fail("Nie udalo sie utworzyc katalogu: " .. tostring(err)) end local backup if existing then local backups = self.root .. "/backups" ok, err = mkdirs(backups) if not ok then return self:_fail("Nie mozna utworzyc kopii: " .. tostring(err)) end for n = 1, 1000 do local candidate = backups .. "/init-" .. os.date("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S") .. "-" .. n .. ".lua" if not read(candidate) then backup = candidate; break end end if not backup then return self:_fail("Nie mozna wybrac nazwy kopii zapasowej.") end local moved, why = os.rename(self.target, backup) if not moved then return self:_fail("Nie mozna zabezpieczyc starej wersji: " .. tostring(why)) end end local moved, why = os.rename(self.waiting, self.target) if not moved then if backup then pcall(os.rename, backup, self.target) end return self:_fail("Blad zapisu wtyczki: " .. tostring(why)) end self:_cleanup(); self.busy, self.release = false, nil say("Zainstalowano AutoExp " .. remote_version .. (backup and " (kopia poprzedniej wersji zachowana)." or ".")) say("Wylacz stary pakiet EXP, a nastepnie wykonaj /przeladuj. Profile expowisk zostaly zachowane.", "light_slate_blue") end
function U:_downloaded(stage, filename) local body = read(filename) if not body then return self:_fail("Nie mozna odczytac pobranego pliku.") end if stage == "manifest" then local release = parse_manifest(body) pcall(os.remove, filename) if not release then return self:_fail("GitHub zwrocil nieprawidlowy manifest.") end self.release = release local installed = plugin_version(read(self.target)) local existing = read(self.target) if existing and not installed then return self:_fail("Obca lub uszkodzona wtyczka. Nie nadpisuje jej.") end local cmp = compare(installed, release.version) if not cmp then return self:_fail("Niepoprawny numer wersji na GitHubie.") end if cmp >= 0 then self:_cleanup(); self.busy, self.release = false, nil if self.verbose then say("ChimeraXP jest aktualna (" .. (installed or "brak") .. ").") end return end self:_fetch("plugin", self.base .. "plugins/chimera_autoexp/init.lua?v=" .. release.version) elseif stage == "plugin" then if not self.release then return self:_fail("Utracono dane wersji.") end self:_install(body, self.release.version) end end
-- Called from /exp aktualizuj (verbose=true) or on every profile startup. function U:check(verbose) if self.busy then if verbose then say("Pobieranie aktualizacji juz trwa.") end return false end local ok, err = mkdirs(self.root) if not ok then say("Brak dostepu do katalogu ChimeraXP: " .. tostring(err), "tomato"); return false end if type(downloadFile) ~= "function" then say("Twoja wersja Mudleta nie obsluguje downloadFile().", "tomato") return false end self.busy, self.verbose = true, verbose == true self:_fetch("manifest", self.base .. "manifest.json") return true end
-- Each profile has its own package script/global and its own plugin directory. -- Do not reload an active patrol automatically when an update arrives. U:_cleanup() U.busy, U.release = false, nil if type(tempTimer) == "function" then tempTimer(0, function() U:check(false) end) else U:check(false) end
